topics.title: Hallmarks of cancer and carcinogenesis
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 1 (Cancer Biology and Carcinogenesis)

mustKnow.fact: Hanahan and Weinberg define hallmark traits including sustaining proliferative signalling, evading growth suppressors, and resisting cell death.
Genomic instability is an enabling characteristic that accelerates the acquisition of cancer hallmarks by increasing mutation rates.
TP53 on chromosome 17p encodes p53, the guardian of the genome, inducing cell cycle arrest via p21 or apoptosis following DNA damage.
RB1 on chromosome 13q regulates the G1-S checkpoint by sequestering E2F transcription factors until phosphorylated by CDK4/6-cyclin D complexes.
The Warburg effect describes aerobic glycolysis where malignant cells preferentially convert glucose to lactate even in the presence of oxygen.
Telomerase activation or alternative lengthening of telomeres confers replicative immortality by maintaining telomere repeat length beyond the Hayflick limit.
Knudson two-hit hypothesis dictates that tumour suppressor gene inactivation requires loss of function of both alleles, typically via mutation and 17p or 13q deletion.
VEGF-mediated angiogenesis is triggered by hypoxia-inducible factor 1-alpha stabilisation under low oxygen conditions to sprout neo-vessels.

modules.name: Hereditary cancer syndromes and genetic counselling

topics.title: Hereditary cancer syndromes and genetic counselling
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 4 (Genetic Counseling and Testing)

mustKnow.fact: BRCA1 on chromosome 17q and BRCA2 on chromosome 13q encode tumour suppressor proteins central to homologous recombination DNA double-strand break repair.
Lynch syndrome is caused by germline mutations in mismatch repair genes MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, and PMS2 or EPCAM deletions, elevating colorectal and endometrial risk.
Li-Fraumeni syndrome arises from germline TP53 mutations predisposing to early-onset sarcomas, breast cancer, adrenocortical carcinoma, and brain tumours.
Familial adenomatous polyposis results from germline APC mutations on chromosome 5q21, conferring near 100% colorectal cancer risk without prophylactic colectomy.
Cowden syndrome features germline PTEN mutations leading to mucocutaneous trichilemmomas, macrocephaly, and elevated breast, thyroid, and endometrial risks.
Peutz-Jeghers syndrome is caused by STK11 mutations and presents with mucocutaneous melanin pigmentation and hamartomatous gastrointestinal polyps.
Von Hippel-Lindau disease is caused by VHL mutations on chromosome 3p, predisposing to clear cell renal carcinoma, retinal angiomas, and pheochromocytomas.
Risk-reducing salpingo-oophorectomy is recommended for BRCA1 carriers between age 35 to 40 years and BRCA2 carriers between 40 to 45 years.

topics.title: Molecular diagnostics and predictive biomarkers
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 11 (Molecular Diagnostics and Predictive Biomarkers)

mustKnow.fact: Next-generation sequencing enables comprehensive genomic profiling identifying actionable single-nucleotide variants, insertions, deletions, and structural fusions.
Liquid biopsy detects circulating tumour DNA in peripheral blood plasma, enabling non-invasive monitoring of minimal residual disease and acquired resistance mutations.
Tumour mutational burden assesses somatic mutations per megabase, with 10 or more mutations per megabase supporting pembrolizumab monotherapy.
Microsatellite instability testing evaluates repeat sequence contraction or expansion via PCR or immunohistochemical loss of MLH1, MSH2, MSH6, and PMS2.
PD-L1 immunohistochemistry uses tumour proportion score in NSCLC and combined positive score in gastric, urothelial, and cervical carcinomas.

Homologous recombination deficiency testing combines BRCA mutation detection with genomic instability scores measuring loss of heterozygosity, telomeric allelic imbalance, and large-scale state transitions.
Minimal residual disease assays tracking leukaemia-specific immunoglobulin rearrangements or BCR-ABL transcripts define deep remission and post-therapy relapse risk.
ESMO Scale for Clinical Actionability of molecular Targets classifies genomic alterations into tier I targets with proven clinical utility down to tier V investigational targets.

topics.title: Tumour markers
topics.book: Harrison 22e Ch. 73 (Approach to the Patient with Cancer & Tumour Markers)

mustKnow.fact: Carcinoembryonic antigen CEA is an oncofetal glycoprotein monitored in colorectal cancer recurrence, with half-life of 2 to 8 days.
CA 125 is an ovarian epithelial tumour marker elevated in serous carcinoma, pelvic inflammatory disease, cirrhosis, and endometriosis.
CA 19-9 is a sialylated Lewis blood group antigen elevated in pancreatic and cholangiocarcinoma, but uninformative in Lewis-negative individuals lacking fucosyltransferase.
Alpha-fetoprotein AFP is elevated in hepatocellular carcinoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumours, with a clearance half-life of 5 to 7 days.
Beta-hCG is secreted by syncytiotrophoblasts in gestational trophoblastic disease and germ cell tumours, having a plasma half-life of 24 to 36 hours.
Prostate-specific antigen PSA is a serine protease produced by prostatic epithelium, monitored for screening, biochemical recurrence, and response to androgen deprivation.
Calcitonin is produced by thyroid parafollicular C cells and serves as the primary diagnostic and monitoring tumour marker for medullary thyroid cancer.
Lactate dehydrogenase LDH serves as a key prognostic marker in non-Hodgkin lymphoma, Hodgkin lymphoma, germ cell tumours, and melanoma.

modules.name: Staging, performance status and response assessment

topics.title: Staging, performance status and response assessment
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 22 (Clinical Trials & RECIST 1.1 Criteria)

mustKnow.fact: AJCC/UICC 8th Edition TNM staging incorporates anatomical tumour extent, regional nodal involvement, distant metastases, and prognostic molecular biomarkers.
ECOG performance status scales functional reserve from 0 for fully active to 4 for completely bedbound, guiding systemic chemotherapy eligibility.
RECIST 1.1 defines partial response as at least a 30% decrease and progressive disease as at least a 20% increase in the sum of longest diameters of target lesions.
iRECIST addresses immune-checkpoint pseudoprogression by requiring confirmation of disease progression 4 to 8 weeks after initial suspected tumour increase.
PERCIST evaluates metabolic tumour response using fluorine-18 fluorodeoxyglucose PET imaging based on SULpeak measurements in target tumour regions.
Lugano classification evaluates lymphoma response using PET-CT and the Deauville 5-point scale, where scores 1 to 3 indicate complete metabolic remission.
RANO criteria assess response in high-grade gliomas by combining MRI contrast enhancement, T2/FLAIR non-enhancing infiltration, and clinical corticosteroid requirement.
mRECIST criteria for hepatocellular carcinoma measure viable tumour demonstrating arterial enhancement rather than total lesion diameter on dynamic contrast CT or MRI.

modules.name: Clinical trial design and evidence in oncology

topics.title: Clinical trial design and evidence in oncology
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 22 (Design and Analysis of Clinical Trials)

mustKnow.fact: Phase I oncology trials determine maximum tolerated dose and dose-limiting toxicities, historically using the classical rule-based 3+3 design.
Phase II trials assess preliminary antitumor activity and objective response rate in defined cohorts before committing to large randomised registration studies.
Phase III randomized controlled trials compare investigational regimens against standard of care, using overall survival as the gold-standard definitive endpoint.
Progression-free survival measures the time from randomisation until objective tumour progression or death from any cause, serving as an earlier surrogate endpoint.
Hazard ratio under the Cox proportional hazards model quantifies relative risk of an event in the experimental arm compared with control throughout study follow-up.
Basket trials evaluate a targeted therapy matching a specific molecular alteration across multiple diverse tumour histological types.
Umbrella trials evaluate multiple targeted treatments matched to different actionable biomarkers within a single histological cancer type.
ESMO Magnitude of Clinical Benefit Scale grades clinical benefit of systemic anticancer therapies from 1 to 5 in curative and non-curative settings.

topics.title: Cancer epidemiology, prevention and screening
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 1 (Global Cancer Incidence and Mortality)

mustKnow.fact: GLOBOCAN and National Cancer Registry Programme data indicate breast cancer is the leading cancer among Indian women, followed by cervical and oral cavity cancers.
Tobacco consumption in smoked and smokeless forms is responsible for over 40% of all cancers in Indian men, especially oral, pharyngeal, and lung carcinomas.
Cervical cancer screening guidelines recommend primary high-risk HPV DNA testing every 5 years or visual inspection with acetic acid VIA in low-resource settings.
mustKnow.source: WHO Cervical Screening Guidelines / Operational Framework India

mustKnow.fact: Screening mammography reduces breast cancer mortality and is recommended biennially for average-risk women between ages 50 and 74 years.
Low-dose helical CT screening in individuals with significant smoking history reduces lung cancer mortality as demonstrated in the landmark NLST and NELSON trials.
Colorectal cancer screening using colonoscopy every 10 years or annual fecal immunochemical testing FIT significantly reduces incidence and mortality.
HPV vaccination targeting oncogenic genotypes 16 and 18 provides robust primary prevention against cervical, anal, and oropharyngeal carcinomas.
mustKnow.source: WHO Position Paper on HPV Vaccines

mustKnow.fact: Universal neonatal hepatitis B vaccination prevents chronic hepatitis B infection and markedly decreases childhood and adult hepatocellular carcinoma incidence.

topics.title: Principles of cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 6 (Principles of Chemotherapy and Pharmacokinetics)

mustKnow.fact: The Skipper log-kill hypothesis postulates that a given dose of cytotoxic chemotherapy kills a constant fractional proportion of tumour cells rather than a constant absolute number.
The Goldie-Coldman hypothesis predicts that spontaneous drug-resistant malignant clones arise early with tumour expansion, necessitating upfront combination chemotherapy.
Dose intensity represents drug delivered per unit time, while dose density compresses intervals between cycles with haematopoietic colony-stimulating factor support.
Calvert formula calculates total carboplatin dose in milligrams as target AUC multiplied by the sum of glomerular filtration rate plus 25.
Neoadjuvant systemic therapy downsizes primary tumours to facilitate organ preservation and provides in vivo assessment of treatment response.
Adjuvant chemotherapy eradicates occult micrometastatic disease following curative-intent surgical resection, reducing long-term relapse risk.
Metronomic chemotherapy administers frequent, low-dose cytotoxic agents without extended rest periods, primarily exerting anti-angiogenic and immunomodulatory effects.
Multidrug resistance 1 gene ABCB1 encodes P-glycoprotein, an ATP-dependent efflux pump that extrudes anthracyclines, taxanes, and vinca alkaloids from tumour cells.

topics.title: Alkylating agents and platinum compounds
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 6 (Alkylating Agents and Platinum Analogs)

mustKnow.fact: Cyclophosphamide and ifosfamide require hepatic CYP2B6 bioactivation to 4-hydroxy metabolites and generate acrolein, the causative metabolite of haemorrhagic cystitis.
Mesna 2-mercaptoethanesulfonate detoxifies acrolein in the urinary bladder via stable thioether conjugation, preventing cytotoxic urothelial ulceration.
Cisplatin forms intrastrand guanine-guanine crosslinks inducing DNA double-strand breaks, but carries high nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, and emetogenicity risks.
Carboplatin produces equivalent platinum DNA adducts with lower renal and neural toxicity but significantly greater myelosuppressive thrombocytopenia.
Oxaliplatin induces bulky DNA-platinum adducts that evade mismatch repair recognition, with a signature acute cold-induced peripheral sensory neuropathy.
Temozolomide is an oral alkylating prodrug that spontaneously hydrolyses to MTIC, crossing the blood-brain barrier to treat high-grade gliomas.
Busulfan is an alkyl sulfonate used in myeloablative conditioning regimens, carrying risk of sinusoidal obstruction syndrome and pulmonary interstitial fibrosis.
Therapy-related myeloid neoplasms arising after alkylating agents characteristically manifest after 5 to 7 years with complex cytogenetics and 5q or 7q deletions.

topics.title: Antimetabolites
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 8 (Antimetabolites)

mustKnow.fact: Methotrexate competitively inhibits dihydrofolate reductase DHFR, depleting tetrahydrofolate and blocking purine and thymidylate biosynthesis.
Leucovorin folinic acid bypasses dihydrofolate reductase inhibition, rescuing non-malignant marrow and mucosal tissues during high-dose methotrexate regimens.
5-Fluorouracil is converted to FdUMP, which forms an inactive ternary complex with thymidylate synthase and methylene-tetrahydrofolate, inhibiting thymidine synthesis.
Capecitabine is an orally absorbed fluoropyrimidine carbamate carbamate converted into 5-FU sequentially by hepatic carboxylesterase, cytidine deaminase, and intratumoral thymidine phosphorylase.
Gemcitabine is a deoxycytidine analogue that undergoes intracellular phosphorylation to diphosphate and triphosphate forms, inhibiting ribonucleotide reductase and incorporating into DNA.
Pemetrexed is a multi-targeted antifolate requiring mandatory vitamin B12 and folic acid supplementation to prevent life-threatening haematologic and cutaneous toxicity.
Cytarabine ara-C is incorporated into DNA as an antimetabolite; high-dose cytarabine requires serial neurological examinations to detect cerebellar toxicity.
Fludarabine and cladribine are purine nucleoside analogues causing profound, protracted CD4 T-lymphocyte depletion requiring Pneumocystis jirovecii prophylaxis.

topics.title: Anthracyclines, microtubule and topoisomerase agents
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 9 & 10 (Topoisomerase & Microtubule Inhibitors)

mustKnow.fact: Doxorubicin intercalates DNA and inhibits topoisomerase II, carrying a lifetime cumulative dose limit of 450 to 550 mg/m2 to prevent irreversible dilated cardiomyopathy.
Pegylated liposomal doxorubicin encapsulates doxorubicin within stealth liposomes, reducing cardiotoxicity while increasing palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia hand-foot syndrome.
Bleomycin generates reactive oxygen radicals inducing DNA strand cleavage, with a lifetime cumulative dose limit of 400 units due to fatal pulmonary fibrosis.
Paclitaxel hyper-stabilises polymerized beta-tubulin microtubules, preventing spindle disassembly and arresting cell division in the M-phase of the cell cycle.
Nab-paclitaxel utilizes 130 nm human serum albumin-bound nanoparticles, eliminating the need for Cremophor EL and avoiding mandatory corticosteroid premedication.
Vincristine binds tubulin dimers to inhibit microtubule assembly, with dose-limiting neurotoxicity capped at 2 mg single doses to avoid paralytic ileus and severe neuropathy.
Etoposide forms a cleavable ternary complex with topoisomerase II and DNA, causing irreparable double-strand breaks during the late S and G2 phases.
Irinotecan is bioactivated by hepatic carboxylesterase to SN-38, an inhibitor of topoisomerase I associated with acute cholinergic and delayed secretory diarrhoea.

topics.title: Small molecule targeted therapy
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 14 (Small Molecule Targeted Inhibitors)

mustKnow.fact: First-generation EGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitors erlotinib and gefitinib competitively bind the ATP-binding pocket of EGFR, effective against exon 19 deletions and L858R.
Osimertinib is a third-generation irreversible EGFR TKI that selectively overcomes the T790M resistance gatekeeper mutation and penetrates the central nervous system.
Second-generation ALK inhibitors alectinib and brigatinib outperform crizotinib in systemic disease control and brain metastasis prevention in ALK-rearranged NSCLC.
BRAF V600E mutations are effectively targeted by combination BRAF inhibitor dabrafenib and MEK inhibitor trametinib, suppressing paradoxical MAPK reactivation.
PARP inhibitors olaparib and talazoparib trap PARP1 on single-strand DNA breaks, exploiting synthetic lethality in homologous recombination-deficient tumour cells.
CDK4/6 inhibitors palbociclib, ribociclib, and abemaciclib block RB1 phosphorylation, arresting hormone receptor-positive breast cancer cells in G1 phase.
Multi-targeted VEGFR TKIs lenvatinib, cabozantinib, and sorafenib disrupt tumour angiogenesis by inhibiting VEGFR1-3, RET, MET, and FGFR receptors.
Acquired TKI resistance arises through on-target secondary mutations, target gene amplification, or bypass pathway activation including MET amplification and histologic transformation.

modules.name: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody drug conjugates

topics.title: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody drug conjugates
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 17 (Monoclonal Antibodies and Antibody-Drug Conjugates)

mustKnow.fact: Trastuzumab is a humanised IgG1 monoclonal antibody binding subdomain IV of HER2, blocking downstream MAPK and PI3K signaling and activating antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity.
Pertuzumab binds extracellular domain II of HER2, sterically preventing ligand-dependent heterodimerization with HER3 and enhancing HER2 pathway suppression.
Bevacizumab is an anti-VEGF-A humanised monoclonal antibody that inhibits endothelial cell proliferation, vessel sprouting, and vascular permeability.
Cetuximab and panitumumab bind EGFR to block ligand-induced activation, demonstrating efficacy exclusively in RAS and BRAF wild-type colorectal carcinomas.
Trastuzumab deruxtecan T-DXd is an antibody-drug conjugate with a cleavable tetrapeptide linker carrying a topoisomerase I inhibitor payload with a drug-to-antibody ratio of 8.
The bystander effect of T-DXd occurs when membrane-permeable topoisomerase I payload diffuses across cell membranes to kill adjacent tumour cells lacking HER2 expression.
Sacituzumab govitecan targets Trop-2 delivering SN-38 payload via a hydrolysable linker, approved for pretreated metastatic triple-negative and HR+ breast cancers.
Enfortumab vedotin targets Nectin-4, delivering the microtubule-disrupting monomethyl auristatin E payload, transforming treatment paradigms in advanced urothelial carcinoma.

topics.title: Immune checkpoint inhibitors
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 18 (Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors)

mustKnow.fact: PD-1 inhibitors nivolumab and pembrolizumab block PD-1 interactions with PD-L1 and PD-L2, reversing T-cell exhaustion and restoring cytotoxic T-lymphocyte antitumor immunity.
PD-L1 inhibitors atezolizumab, durvalumab, and avelumab prevent PD-L1 from engaging PD-1 and B7.1, leaving the PD-L2/PD-1 regulatory axis intact.
CTLA-4 inhibitor ipilimumab blocks CTLA-4 outcompeting CD28 for B7 costimulatory molecules during initial T-cell priming in secondary lymphoid organs.
Dual immune checkpoint inhibition combining nivolumab and ipilimumab provides synergistic responses in metastatic melanoma, renal cell carcinoma, and MSI-H colorectal cancer.
Relatlimab is an inhibitory antibody targeting LAG-3, combining with nivolumab to overcome adaptive resistance in untreated metastatic melanoma.
Hyperprogression represents an accelerated pattern of tumour growth seen in up to 10% of patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors, correlated with MDM2 amplification.
Pembrolizumab received the first FDA tissue-agnostic approval for any solid tumour exhibiting mismatch repair deficiency or microsatellite instability-high status.
Immune checkpoint inhibitor biomarkers include PD-L1 expression, high tumour mutational burden, microsatellite instability, and immune gene expression signatures.

topics.title: Cellular therapy and bispecific antibodies
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 20 (Cellular Therapies and Bispecific Antibodies)

mustKnow.fact: Chimeric antigen receptor CAR-T cell therapy genetically engineers autologous T cells to express synthetic receptors targeting CD19 or BCMA independently of MHC.
Cytokine release syndrome CRS is a systemic inflammatory response driven by interleukin-6, interferon-gamma, and TNF-alpha following CAR-T cell expansion.
Tocilizumab, an interleukin-6 receptor antagonist, is the primary first-line therapeutic agent for moderate-to-severe cytokine release syndrome.
Immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome ICANS presents with expressive aphasia, cognitive slowing, tremors, and cerebral oedema managed primarily with dexamethasone.
Blinatumomab is a bispecific T-cell engager BiTE directing CD3+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes to lyse CD19+ B-precursor acute lymphoblastic leukaemia cells.
Teclistamab is a humanised bispecific antibody targeting both CD3 on T cells and B-cell maturation antigen BCMA on multiple myeloma cells.
Tebentafusp is a bispecific gp100 peptide-HLA-A*02:01-directed T-cell receptor therapeutic fusion protein improving overall survival in HLA-A*02:01+ metastatic uveal melanoma.
Lifileucel is an autologous tumour-infiltrating lymphocyte TIL therapy expanded ex vivo with interleukin-2 for pretreated unresectable or metastatic melanoma.

topics.title: Endocrine therapy in oncology
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 16 (Endocrine Therapies in Oncology)

mustKnow.fact: Tamoxifen is a selective oestrogen receptor modulator SERM competitively inhibiting oestrogen binding in breast tissue while acting as an agonist in endometrium and bone.
Aromatase inhibitors anastrozole, letrozole, and exemestane block the peripheral conversion of androgens to estrogens, requiring postmenopausal status or ovarian suppression.
Fulvestrant is an injectable selective oestrogen receptor down-regulator SERD that competitively binds, immobilises, and accelerates the degradation of oestrogen receptor alpha.
Elacestrant is an oral SERD approved for metastatic ER-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer harbouring ESR1 mutations progressing after prior endocrine therapy.
GnRH agonists goserelin and leuprolide produce an initial flare of gonadotropins before down-regulating pituitary GnRH receptors and inducing medical castration.
GnRH antagonists degarelix and relugolix competitively block pituitary GnRH receptors, achieving rapid testosterone suppression without the risk of an initial surge or flare.
Abiraterone acetate irreversibly inhibits CYP17A1 17-alpha-hydroxylase and C17,20-lyase, necessitating coadministration with prednisone to avoid secondary mineralocorticoid excess.
Second-generation androgen receptor inhibitors enzalutamide, apalutamide, and darolutamide prevent androgen binding, nuclear translocation, and DNA transcription in prostate cancer.

topics.title: Tissue agnostic and precision oncology
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 14 (Tissue-Agnostic Approvals in Precision Oncology)

mustKnow.fact: NTRK gene fusions NTRK1, NTRK2, NTRK3 encode oncogenic chimeric TRK kinases sensitive to selective TRK inhibitors larotrectinib and entrectinib across all histologies.
MSI-H and mismatch repair-deficient dMMR solid tumours demonstrate profound, durable responsiveness to immune checkpoint inhibitors regardless of anatomical origin.
High tumour mutational burden defined as 10 or more mutations per megabase serves as a tumour-agnostic predictive biomarker for pembrolizumab monotherapy.
BRAF V600E mutation combination therapy with dabrafenib and trametinib carries tissue-agnostic approval for all advanced solid tumours lacking satisfactory alternative options.
RET gene fusions and activating RET mutations across diverse solid tumours respond to highly selective RET inhibitors selpercatinib and pralsetinib.
HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate trastuzumab deruxtecan is approved tumour-agnostically for pretreated unresectable or metastatic HER2 IHC 3+ solid tumours.
Molecular tumour boards integrate comprehensive genomic sequencing data with clinical trials, evaluating variant pathogenicity according to AMP/ASCO/CAP tier criteria.
Clonal versus subclonal driver status determines durable targeted efficacy: subclonal alterations demonstrate lower response rates due to outgrowth of negative tumour clones.

topics.title: Pharmacogenomics and drug interactions
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 7 (Pharmacogenomics in Anticancer Therapy)

mustKnow.fact: Dihydropyrimidine dehydrogenase DPYD deficiency impairs 5-FU and capecitabine catabolism, causing potentially fatal myelosuppression and mucositis without upfront dose reduction.
UGT1A1*28 polymorphism with homozygous 7/7 TA repeats diminishes glucuronidation of SN-38, substantially increasing severe neutropenia and diarrhoea with irinotecan.
Thiopurine S-methyltransferase TPMT and NUDT15 polymorphisms reduce thiopurine detoxification, dictating 50% to 90% dose reductions for 6-mercaptopurine.
CYP2D6 poor metabolizer status impairs the bioactivation of tamoxifen to active endoxifen, decreasing therapeutic efficacy in early breast cancer.
Potent CYP3A4 inhibitors like ketoconazole or clarithromycin increase plasma exposures of tyrosine kinase inhibitors, necessitating preemptive TKI dose reductions.
Proton pump inhibitors and H2-receptor antagonists reduce gastric acidity, severely impairing the oral bioavailability and clinical absorption of erlotinib, dasatinib, and pazopanib.
QTc prolongation is a class toxicity of multiple tyrosine kinase inhibitors and antiemetics, requiring ECG baseline assessment and avoidance of QTc-prolonging comedications.
Renal dose adjustments based on creatinine clearance are mandatory for renally eliminated cytotoxic agents including cisplatin, carboplatin, capecitabine, and bleomycin.

modules.name: Radiation oncology for the medical oncologist

topics.title: Radiation oncology for the medical oncologist
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 5 (Essentials of Radiation Therapy)

mustKnow.fact: The linear-quadratic model quantifies radiation cell kill, where the alpha parameter represents single-hit irreparable lethal events and beta represents sublethal damage repair.

The alpha to beta ratio describes tissue fractionation sensitivity: early responding tissues and tumours exhibit high ratios around 10 Gy, whereas late-responding tissues have low ratios of 2 to 3 Gy.

Concurrent chemoradiation utilizes radiosensitizing cytotoxics like cisplatin or 5-FU to inhibit repair of radiation-induced DNA lesions, outperforming sequential therapy in cervical and head/neck cancers.
Stereotactic body radiotherapy SBRT delivers ablative, highly conformal radiation doses in 1 to 5 fractions with steep dose fall-off, ideal for early NSCLC and oligometastases.
The abscopal effect describes regression of distant, non-irradiated metastatic tumour lesions following localized radiotherapy, mediated by systemic immune activation.
Radiation recall dermatitis presents as acute inflammatory skin erythema at a previously irradiated site triggered by subsequent administration of taxanes, anthracyclines, or gemcitabine.
Brachytherapy places sealed radioisotopes directly within or immediately adjacent to tumour tissue, maximizing target dose while sparing adjacent critical organs in cervical and prostate cancers.
Oligometastatic cancer defined as 1 to 5 discrete metastases represents an intermediate state where local consolidative radiotherapy or surgery significantly improves overall survival.

topics.title: NSCLC diagnosis, pathology and staging
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 30 (Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer: Diagnosis and Staging)

mustKnow.fact: Adenocarcinoma is characterised immunohistochemically by positive TTF-1 and napsin A, whereas squamous cell carcinoma demonstrates positive p40 and p63 staining.
EBUS-TBNA endobronchial ultrasound transbronchial needle aspiration is the primary minimally invasive investigation of choice for mediastinal lymph node staging in NSCLC.
Whole-body 18F-FDG PET-CT and contrast-enhanced brain MRI are essential mandatory staging investigations for all candidate non-small cell lung cancer patients prior to radical curative therapy.
Reflex molecular biomarker testing in advanced non-squamous NSCLC mandates evaluation of EGFR, ALK, ROS1, BRAF, RET, MET exon 14, KRAS G12C, NTRK, and PD-L1 TPS.
TNM 8th edition lung cancer staging classifies solitary tumour nodule 3 cm or less as T1, greater than 3 to 5 cm as T2, and separate tumour nodule in another ipsilateral lobe as T4.
Pancoast superior sulcus tumours invade the brachial plexus and cervical sympathetic ganglion, producing Horner syndrome consisting of ptosis, miosis, and anhidrosis.
Solitary pulmonary nodule evaluation utilizes the Brock University risk calculator and Fleischner Society guidelines to stratify malignancy risk and determine CT surveillance intervals.
Invasive mediastinal staging with cervical mediastinoscopy is indicated when EBUS is non-diagnostic or when PET shows central tumours without mediastinal nodal uptake.

modules.name: Early stage and locally advanced NSCLC

topics.title: Early stage and locally advanced NSCLC
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 30 (Early and Locally Advanced NSCLC)

mustKnow.fact: Anatomical lobectomy with systematic hilar and mediastinal lymph node dissection is the surgical standard of care for medically operable stage I and II NSCLC.
Adjuvant osimertinib for 3 years significantly improves disease-free and overall survival in resected stage IB to IIIA EGFR-mutated NSCLC as proven in the ADAURA trial.
Neoadjuvant nivolumab plus platinum doublet chemotherapy demonstrated significantly higher pathological complete response and event-free survival in resectable NSCLC in CheckMate 816.
Perioperative pembrolizumab administered neoadjuvantly with chemotherapy and continued adjuvantly significantly prolonged event-free survival in resectable stage II-IIIB NSCLC in KEYNOTE-671.
Consolidation durvalumab for 12 months following definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy improves overall and progression-free survival in unresectable stage III NSCLC in the PACIFIC trial.
Adjuvant alectinib for up to 2 years significantly reduces recurrence risk compared to platinum-based chemotherapy in completely resected stage IB to IIIA ALK-positive NSCLC in ALINA.
Stereotactic body radiotherapy delivers local control exceeding 90% in medically inoperable stage I peripheral non-small cell lung cancer.
Concurrent chemoradiation using cisplatin and etoposide or pemetrexed represents the definitive standard of care for unresectable locally advanced stage III NSCLC.

topics.title: Oncogene addicted NSCLC
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 30 (Molecularly Targeted Therapy in NSCLC)

mustKnow.fact: EGFR exon 19 in-frame deletions and exon 21 L858R point mutations represent the classical sensitising mutations, comprising approximately 85% of all EGFR-mutant NSCLC.
Osimertinib monotherapy is the first-line standard of care for advanced EGFR-mutated NSCLC based on superior progression-free and overall survival in the FLAURA trial.
First-line lorlatinib demonstrated unprecedented progression-free survival and exceptional CNS intracranial disease protection in untreated ALK-positive NSCLC in the CROWN trial.
ROS1 rearrangements respond to targeted TKIs crizotinib, entrectinib, and repotrectinib, with entrectinib and repotrectinib providing superior central nervous system penetration.
KRAS G12C mutations in NSCLC are selectively inhibited by covalent GDP-bound KRAS inhibitors sotorasib and adagrasib.
MET exon 14 skipping alterations predict profound responsiveness to oral selective MET tyrosine kinase inhibitors capmatinib and tepotinib.
RET gene fusions in non-small cell lung cancer are effectively targeted with potent brain-penetrant RET inhibitors selpercatinib and pralsetinib.
Amivantamab bispecific EGFR-MET antibody plus lazertinib significantly improved PFS over osimertinib in first-line EGFR-mutant advanced NSCLC in the MARIPOSA trial.

topics.title: Immunotherapy-based therapy in advanced NSCLC
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 30 (Immunotherapy in Advanced NSCLC)

mustKnow.fact: Pembrolizumab monotherapy is the established first-line standard for metastatic NSCLC without driver mutations having PD-L1 tumour proportion score TPS 50% or higher based on KEYNOTE-024.
Pembrolizumab plus platinum-pemetrexed significantly improved overall survival over chemotherapy alone in untreated metastatic non-squamous NSCLC regardless of PD-L1 expression in KEYNOTE-189.
In metastatic squamous NSCLC, pembrolizumab combined with carboplatin and paclitaxel or nab-paclitaxel established an overall survival benefit across all PD-L1 tiers in KEYNOTE-407.
CheckMate 9LA proved that dual immunotherapy with nivolumab and ipilimumab combined with only two cycles of chemotherapy improves overall survival in advanced NSCLC.
Atezolizumab monotherapy demonstrated significant overall survival improvement over platinum chemotherapy in advanced NSCLC with high PD-L1 expression in the IMpower110 trial.
Second-line docetaxel with or without the VEGFR2 antagonist ramucirumab represents the cytotoxic standard of care following progression on frontline chemoimmunotherapy.
Maintenance pemetrexed following four cycles of platinum doublet therapy improves overall survival in non-squamous histology as demonstrated in the PARAMOUNT trial.
Bevacizumab addition to carboplatin and paclitaxel improves response and progression-free survival in non-squamous NSCLC but is contraindicated in squamous histology due to fatal haemoptysis.

topics.title: Small cell lung cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 31 (Small Cell and Neuroendocrine Tumors of the Lung)

mustKnow.fact: Small cell lung cancer is clinically divided into limited-stage confined to a tolerable single radiation port and extensive-stage extending beyond the ipsilateral hemithorax.
Limited-stage SCLC standard of care is concurrent accelerated hyperfractionated thoracic radiotherapy 45 Gy in 30 twice-daily fractions with 4 cycles of cisplatin and etoposide.
First-line extensive-stage SCLC requires platinum-etoposide combined with PD-L1 inhibitors atezolizumab or durvalumab, which significantly improves overall survival.
The ADRIATIC trial demonstrated that consolidation durvalumab significantly prolongs overall and progression-free survival following chemoradiotherapy in limited-stage SCLC.
Prophylactic cranial irradiation PCI reduces brain metastasis incidence and improves overall survival in patients with limited-stage SCLC achieving complete or good partial response.
Tarlatamab is a bispecific T-cell engager BiTE targeting delta-like ligand 3 DLL3 and CD3, approved for pretreated extensive-stage small cell lung cancer.
Lurbinectedin is a selective oncogenic transcription and RNA polymerase II inhibitor approved for second-line extensive-stage SCLC progressing after platinum chemotherapy.

Paraneoplastic syndromes frequently associated with SCLC include SIADH caused by ectopic vasopressin secretion and Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome driven by antibodies against P/Q-type voltage-gated calcium channels.

topics.title: Mesothelioma and thymic tumours
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 76 (Pleural Mesothelioma and Mediastinal Neoplasms)

mustKnow.fact: Malignant pleural mesothelioma is strongly linked to crocidolite and chrysotile asbestos exposure, typically manifesting after a clinical latency period of 30 to 50 years.
Mesothelioma is immunohistochemically identified by positive calretinin, WT1, and cytokeratin 5/6, along with characteristic diagnostic loss of BAP1 nuclear expression.
First-line dual immunotherapy with nivolumab and ipilimumab improves overall survival over platinum-pemetrexed in unresectable malignant pleural mesothelioma in CheckMate 743.
Cisplatin and pemetrexed plus the VEGF inhibitor bevacizumab provides an established alternative chemotherapy standard of care for non-immunotherapy candidates.
Thymomas are classified by the Masaoka-Koga staging system from stage I encapsulated macroscopic tumour to stage IV haematogenous or lymphogenous dissemination.
Myasthenia gravis caused by acetylcholine receptor autoantibodies occurs in approximately 30% to 40% of patients diagnosed with anterior mediastinal thymomas.
Thymic carcinoma is distinguished from thymoma by overt cytological atypia, absence of immature T-lymphocytes, and frequent loss of CD5 and CD117 positivity.
First-line systemic therapy for advanced, unresectable thymic carcinoma consists of platinum-based combination chemotherapy such as carboplatin plus paclitaxel.

topics.title: Breast cancer biology and staging
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 53 (Breast Cancer Biology, Pathology and Subtypes)

mustKnow.fact: Estrogen receptor ER and progesterone receptor PR positivity is defined as nuclear immunoreactivity in 1% or more of invasive tumour cell nuclei.
HER2 testing evaluates protein expression by immunohistochemistry from 0 to 3+, with IHC 2+ cases requiring reflex in situ hybridisation FISH to detect gene amplification.
Molecular intrinsic subtypes include Luminal A with high ER and low Ki-67 under 20%, Luminal B with high Ki-67 or HER2+, HER2-enriched, and Basal-like.
Oncotype DX 21-gene recurrence score quantifies distant recurrence risk; TAILORx established that node-negative ER+ breast cancer with scores 0 to 25 derives no chemotherapy benefit.
The RxPONDER trial established that postmenopausal women with ER-positive breast cancer and 1 to 3 positive lymph nodes with recurrence score 0 to 25 safely omit chemotherapy.
MammaPrint 70-gene signature categorises early breast cancer into low and high genomic risk, with the MINDACT trial confirming safety of chemotherapy omission in clinical-high genomic-low disease.
AJCC 8th edition incorporates anatomical tumour size and nodal status with histological grade, ER, PR, HER2, and multigene panel recurrence score into Clinical and Pathological Prognostic Stages.
Ki-67 proliferation index serves as a crucial distinction between slowly proliferating Luminal A-like tumours and biologically aggressive Luminal B-like malignancies.

modules.name: Early hormone receptor positive breast cancer

topics.title: Early hormone receptor positive breast cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 53 (Management of Early-Stage Hormone Receptor-Positive Breast Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: Adjuvant endocrine therapy with tamoxifen for 5 to 10 years significantly reduces breast cancer recurrence and mortality in premenopausal and postmenopausal women.
Third-generation aromatase inhibitors anastrozole, letrozole, or exemestane provide superior disease-free survival compared with tamoxifen in postmenopausal early breast cancer.
The SOFT and TEXT trials demonstrated that ovarian function suppression with GnRH agonists combined with exemestane or tamoxifen improves disease-free survival in high-risk premenopausal women.
Adjuvant abemaciclib combined with endocrine therapy for 2 years significantly reduces invasive disease-free recurrence in node-positive, high-risk early HR+ breast cancer in monarchE.
Adjuvant ribociclib with a non-steroidal aromatase inhibitor for 3 years demonstrates significant invasive disease-free survival improvement in stage II and III HR+ early breast cancer in NATALEE.

Adjuvant olaparib for 1 year significantly prolongs invasive disease-free and overall survival in patients with germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations and high-risk HER2-negative early breast cancer in OlympiA.
Adjuvant bisphosphonate therapy with zoledronic acid or oral clodronate reduces bone recurrence and breast cancer mortality exclusively in postmenopausal women.
Extended endocrine therapy beyond 5 years up to 10 years is recommended for patients with high-risk features like node-positive disease, balanced against cumulative toxicities.

topics.title: HER2-positive breast cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 53 (HER2-Directed Therapy in Early and Advanced Breast Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: One year of adjuvant trastuzumab combined with chemotherapy reduces the risk of breast cancer recurrence by approximately 50% and mortality by 33% in early HER2-positive breast cancer.
Dual HER2 blockade with trastuzumab and pertuzumab combined with chemotherapy significantly improves invasive disease-free survival in high-risk, node-positive early breast cancer in APHINITY.
In patients with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant HER2-targeted chemotherapy, adjuvant ado-trastuzumab emtansine T-DM1 reduces recurrence risk by 50% compared to trastuzumab in KATHERINE.
First-line standard of care for metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer is docetaxel, trastuzumab, and pertuzumab, which established median overall survival of nearly 5 years in the CLEOPATRA trial.

Trastuzumab deruxtecan T-DXd demonstrated significant progression-free and overall survival superiority over T-DM1 as second-line therapy for metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer in DESTINY-Breast03.

Tucatinib combined with trastuzumab and capecitabine demonstrates superior progression-free survival and overall survival in patients with active and treated HER2-positive brain metastases in HER2CLIMB.

Cardiotoxicity from trastuzumab is typically reversible, non-dose-dependent, and characterised by asymptomatic declines in left ventricular ejection fraction LVEF requiring regular echocardiographic monitoring.
Pathological complete response pCR after neoadjuvant dual anti-HER2 therapy strongly correlates with excellent long-term event-free and overall survival outcomes.

topics.title: Triple negative breast cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 53 (Systemic Therapy of Triple-Negative Breast Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: Neoadjuvant pembrolizumab added to anthracycline, cyclophosphamide, and taxane-carboplatin chemotherapy significantly increases pathological complete response and event-free survival in KEYNOTE-522.
Adjuvant capecitabine for 6 to 8 cycles improves disease-free and overall survival in triple-negative breast cancer patients with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant chemotherapy in CREATE-X.
Sacituzumab govitecan is an anti-Trop-2 antibody-drug conjugate providing significant PFS and OS benefit over single-agent chemotherapy in pretreated metastatic TNBC in the ASCENT trial.
First-line pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy significantly improves progression-free and overall survival in metastatic TNBC with PD-L1 combined positive score CPS 10 or higher in KEYNOTE-355.

PARP inhibitors olaparib and talazoparib demonstrate superior progression-free survival compared to standard chemotherapy in metastatic HER2-negative breast cancer harbouring germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations.
Platinum agents carboplatin or cisplatin increase pathological complete response rates when incorporated into neoadjuvant regimens for early-stage triple-negative breast cancer.
Datopotamab deruxtecan is a TROP2-directed ADC demonstrating clinically meaningful activity in heavily pretreated inoperable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer.
Triple-negative breast cancer comprises diverse transcriptomic subtypes including basal-like 1, basal-like 2, mesenchymal, and luminal androgen receptor LAR phenotypes.

modules.name: Metastatic hormone receptor positive breast cancer

topics.title: Metastatic hormone receptor positive breast cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 53 (Endocrine and Targeted Therapy for Metastatic HR+ Breast Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: First-line CDK4/6 inhibitors palbociclib, ribociclib, or abemaciclib combined with aromatase inhibitors significantly prolong progression-free survival beyond 2 years in metastatic HR+ breast cancer.
Ribociclib combined with endocrine therapy is the first CDK4/6 inhibitor demonstrating a statistically significant overall survival benefit exceeding 5 years across pre- and postmenopausal cohorts.
Fulvestrant combined with abemaciclib, ribociclib, or palbociclib represents the evidence-based standard of care for second-line metastatic HR+ breast cancer progressing on aromatase inhibitors.
Activating ESR1 ligand-binding domain mutations drive acquired resistance to aromatase inhibitors, successfully treated with oral selective estrogen receptor degrader elacestrant in EMERALD.
Alpelisib, an alpha-specific PI3K inhibitor, combined with fulvestrant significantly improves progression-free survival in PIK3CA-mutated HR+ advanced breast cancer in the SOLAR-1 trial.
Capivasertib is a potent pan-AKT kinase inhibitor approved with fulvestrant for advanced HR+ breast cancer harboring one or more alterations in PIK3CA, AKT1, or PTEN in CAPItello-291.
Trastuzumab deruxtecan established a new standard of care for HER2-low metastatic breast cancer IHC 1+ or IHC 2+/FISH-negative, significantly improving PFS and OS in DESTINY-Breast04.
Everolimus is an oral mTORC1 inhibitor combined with exemestane that overcomes endocrine resistance and improves progression-free survival in aromatase inhibitor-refractory disease in BOLERO-2.

topics.title: Special situations in breast cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 53 (Special Presentations and Rare Histologies of Breast Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: Male breast cancer accounts for under 1% of all breast cancers, is predominantly estrogen receptor-positive ductal carcinoma, and strongly correlates with germline BRCA2 mutations.

Breast cancer in pregnancy can be safely managed with anthracycline-based systemic chemotherapy administered exclusively during the second and third trimesters, avoiding radiation and endocrine agents until postpartum.
mustKnow.source: ESMO Breast Cancer in Pregnancy Guidelines

mustKnow.fact: Inflammatory breast cancer presents with rapid breast enlargement, peau d'orange, and dermal lymphatic tumour emboli on skin biopsy, classified as clinical stage T4d.
Phyllodes tumours are fibroepithelial neoplasms categorized histologically into benign, borderline, and malignant grades based on stromal cellularity, mitotic rate, and infiltrative margins.

Ductal carcinoma in situ DCIS is treated with breast-conserving surgery followed by adjuvant whole-breast radiotherapy and 5 years of adjuvant tamoxifen to reduce ipsilateral and contralateral recurrence.
Paget disease of the nipple manifests as an eczematoid nipple erosion with malignant intraepidermal Paget cells, associated with underlying ductal carcinoma in situ or invasive adenocarcinoma.
Comprehensive geriatric assessment tools including the CARG toxicity calculator stratify chemotherapy tolerance and predict severe grade 3 to 5 toxicities in elderly breast cancer patients.

Oligometastatic breast cancer with solitary or limited visceral or skeletal metastases may achieve prolonged disease-free intervals with local ablative surgery or stereotactic radiotherapy combined with systemic therapy.

topics.title: Oesophageal and gastric cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 33 & 34 (Cancer of the Esophagus and Stomach)

mustKnow.fact: Siewert classification categorises adenocarcinoma of the gastro-oesophageal junction into type I distal oesophagus, type II true cardia, and type III subcardial gastric origin.
Neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy with carboplatin and paclitaxel plus 41.4 Gy radiation significantly improves overall survival in resectable oesophageal and GEJ cancer in the CROSS trial.
Adjuvant nivolumab for 1 year significantly doubles disease-free survival in resected oesophageal or GEJ cancer with residual pathological disease after neoadjuvant chemoradiation in CheckMate 577.
Perioperative FLOT fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin, docetaxel 4 cycles pre- and post-operatively improves overall survival compared to ECF/ECX in gastric and GEJ adenocarcinoma in FLOT4.

Trastuzumab added to cisplatin and fluoropyrimidine significantly prolongs overall survival in untreated HER2-positive advanced gastric or gastro-oesophageal junction adenocarcinoma in the ToGA trial.

Zolbetuximab, a monoclonal antibody targeting Claudin 18.2, combined with chemotherapy significantly improves PFS and OS in Claudin 18.2-positive, HER2-negative advanced gastric adenocarcinoma in SPOTLIGHT.
First-line nivolumab added to FOLFOX or CAPOX significantly prolongs overall survival in advanced gastric and GEJ cancer with PD-L1 combined positive score CPS 5 or higher in CheckMate 649.
D2 lymphadenectomy dissecting perigastric nodes and nodes along the celiac axis and branches is the gold-standard surgical oncological procedure for curative gastric cancer resection.

topics.title: Localized colon and rectal cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 40 & 41 (Localized Colon and Rectal Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: Adjuvant fluoropyrimidine plus oxaliplatin FOLFOX or CAPOX significantly reduces recurrence risk in resected stage III colon cancer, with benefits confirmed in the MOSAIC trial.
The international IDEA trial established that 3 months of adjuvant CAPOX is non-inferior to 6 months in low-risk stage III colon cancer T1-3, N1, reducing sensory neurotoxicity.
Mismatch repair deficiency dMMR or MSI-H in stage II colon cancer confers a favourable natural prognosis but predicts lack of benefit from single-agent 5-FU adjuvant chemotherapy.

High-risk stage II colon cancer features include T4 primary tumour, bowel obstruction or perforation, poor histology, lymphovascular invasion, perineural invasion, and fewer than 12 sampled lymph nodes.

Total neoadjuvant therapy TNT administering short-course radiotherapy or chemoradiation with consolidation chemotherapy significantly reduces distant metastasis in locally advanced rectal cancer in RAPIDO.
PRODIGE 23 proved that neoadjuvant mFOLFIRINOX followed by chemoradiotherapy and total mesorectal excision significantly improves disease-free survival in locally advanced rectal cancer.
Dostarlimab monotherapy for 6 months produced a 100% clinical complete response rate without surgery or chemoradiation in mismatch repair-deficient locally advanced rectal cancer.
Watch-and-wait non-operative organ preservation is viable in rectal cancer patients achieving a confirmed clinical complete response after total neoadjuvant therapy.

topics.title: Metastatic colorectal cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 40 (Metastatic Colorectal Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: Extended RAS KRAS and NRAS exons 2, 3, 4 and BRAF V600E mutation testing is mandatory prior to selecting targeted biologics in metastatic colorectal cancer.
Primary tumour sidedness dictates frontline EGFR therapy: anti-EGFR antibodies cetuximab and panitumumab improve survival only in left-sided RAS/BRAF wild-type colorectal tumours.
Right-sided metastatic colorectal cancer derives primary benefit from bevacizumab combined with cytotoxic doublets or triplets rather than anti-EGFR monoclonal antibodies.
The BEACON CRC trial established encorafenib BRAF inhibitor plus cetuximab as the standard of care for pretreated BRAF V600E-mutant metastatic colorectal cancer.
Pembrolizumab monotherapy demonstrated significant progression-free survival superiority over frontline chemotherapy in microsatellite instability-high metastatic colorectal cancer in KEYNOTE-177.
Trifluridine-tipiracil TAS-102 combined with bevacizumab significantly improves progression-free and overall survival in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer in the SUNLIGHT trial.
Fruquintinib is a highly selective oral VEGFR1-3 tyrosine kinase inhibitor improving overall survival in refractory metastatic colorectal cancer in the FRESCO-2 trial.
Complete surgical resection of isolated colorectal liver metastases provides long-term 5-year overall survival rates reaching 40% to 50% in selected patients.

modules.name: Anal canal, small bowel and appendiceal cancers

topics.title: Anal canal, small bowel and appendiceal cancers
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 38 & 42 (Small Bowel, Appendix and Anal Cancers)

mustKnow.fact: Anal canal squamous cell carcinoma is predominantly driven by high-risk human papillomavirus HPV genotypes 16 and 18, strongly associated with receptive anal intercourse and immunosuppression.
The Nigro protocol combining external beam radiotherapy with concurrent 5-fluorouracil and mitomycin C achieves curative organ preservation in localized anal squamous carcinoma.
Abdominoperineal resection with permanent end colostomy is reserved as salvage therapy exclusively for persistent or recurrent local disease following definitive chemoradiotherapy.
Small bowel adenocarcinoma occurs predominantly in the duodenum and jejunum, enriched for Lynch syndrome mismatch repair mutations and predisposing Crohn disease.
Ampullary carcinomas arise from the ampulla of Vater and are classified histologically into intestinal-type managed similarly to colorectal adenocarcinoma or pancreatobiliary-type.
Low-grade appendiceal mucinous neoplasms LAMN can rupture into the peritoneal cavity causing pseudomyxoma peritonei characterized by progressive gelatinous mucinous ascites.
Cytoreductive surgery combined with hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy HIPEC using mitomycin or oxaliplatin achieves long-term disease control in selected pseudomyxoma peritonei.
Pembrolizumab is effective and approved in advanced, refractory small bowel adenocarcinomas exhibiting high microsatellite instability MSI-H or high tumour mutational burden.

topics.title: Pancreatic cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 35 (Cancer of the Pancreas)

mustKnow.fact: Pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma is staged as resectable, borderline resectable, locally advanced unresectable, or metastatic based on mesenteric vessel interface on triphasic helical pancreatic CT.
Adjuvant modified FOLFIRINOX for 6 months significantly improves disease-free and overall survival compared to gemcitabine in resected pancreatic cancer in PRODIGE 24/CCTG PA.6.
First-line metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma standard of care comprises either modified FOLFIRINOX or gemcitabine combined with nab-paclitaxel based on the MPACT trial.
NALIRIFOX liposomal irinotecan, 5-FU/leucovorin, and oxaliplatin demonstrated significant overall survival superiority over gemcitabine plus nab-paclitaxel in NAPOLI 3.

Maintenance olaparib PARP inhibitor significantly improves progression-free survival in metastatic pancreatic cancer harbouring germline BRCA1 or BRCA2 mutations responding to platinum in the POLO trial.
Activating KRAS point mutations, primarily G12D, G12V, and G12R, occur in over 90% of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinomas, initiating early oncogenic cellular transformation.
Pancreaticoduodenectomy Whipple procedure is the standard surgical resection for pancreatic head tumours, requiring negative histological resection margins for long-term cure.
Elevated baseline serum CA 19-9 above 1,000 U/mL in seemingly localized pancreatic cancer strongly correlates with occult peritoneal or distant micrometastatic disease.

topics.title: Hepatocellular carcinoma
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 36 (Primary Neoplasms of the Liver)

mustKnow.fact: The Barcelona Clinic Liver Cancer BCLC staging system integrates tumour burden, Child-Pugh liver functional class, and ECOG performance status into treatment algorithms from stage 0 to D.
LI-RADS CT/MRI reporting standardises radiological diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma based on arterial phase hyperenhancement and late phase venous washout without mandatory biopsy.
First-line systemic therapy with atezolizumab plus bevacizumab significantly improves overall survival over sorafenib in unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma in IMbrave150.
Single tremelimumab regular interval durvalumab STRIDE regimen in the HIMALAYA trial demonstrated significant overall survival superiority compared to sorafenib in advanced HCC.
Lenvatinib is non-inferior to sorafenib in overall survival and significantly improves objective response rate and progression-free survival in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma in the REFLECT trial.
Transarterial chemoembolization TACE is the recommended locoregional therapy for intermediate stage BCLC-B unresectable multinodular hepatocellular carcinoma with preserved portal flow.
Milan criteria for liver transplantation define eligibility as a solitary HCC nodule 5 cm or less, or up to 3 nodules each 3 cm or less without vascular invasion or metastases.
Serum alpha-fetoprotein AFP levels of 400 ng/mL or higher in a cirrhotic patient with a hypervascular hepatic mass are strongly diagnostic of hepatocellular carcinoma.

topics.title: Biliary tract cancers
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 37 (Biliary Tract and Gallbladder Carcinoma)

mustKnow.fact: Cholangiocarcinomas are anatomically categorized into intrahepatic, perihilar Klatskin tumours, and distal extrahepatic subtypes, with distinct molecular profiles and surgical approaches.
First-line durvalumab combined with gemcitabine and cisplatin significantly improves overall survival in advanced biliary tract cancer in the landmark TOPAZ-1 trial.
Gemcitabine and cisplatin established the first cytotoxic systemic standard of care for locally advanced or metastatic biliary tract carcinoma in the ABC-02 trial.
Adjuvant capecitabine for 8 cycles following curative resection of biliary tract cancer and gallbladder cancer improves overall survival as demonstrated in the BILCAP trial.
FGFR2 gene fusions occur in 10% to 15% of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinomas, successfully targeted by selective FGFR kinase inhibitors pemigatinib and futibatinib.
IDH1 R132 mutations occur in up to 20% of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinomas, inhibited by oral mutant IDH1 inhibitor ivosidenib in ClarIDHy.

Gallbladder carcinoma is the most common biliary malignancy, highly prevalent in northern India, strongly linked to chronic cholelithiasis, porcelain gallbladder, and anomalous pancreaticobiliary duct junction.
Primary sclerosing cholangitis PSC is an inflammatory fibrostenotic hepatobiliary disorder conferring an annual 1% to 1.5% incidence of developing cholangiocarcinoma.

topics.title: Gastrointestinal stromal tumour
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 39 (Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumors)

mustKnow.fact: Gastrointestinal stromal tumours GIST arise from interstitial cells of Cajal, defined by uniform immunohistochemical positivity for KIT CD117 and DOG1 anoctamin-1.
KIT exon 11 mutations represent the most common oncogenic driver in GIST, predicting exquisite sensitivity to the tyrosine kinase inhibitor imatinib.
PDGFRA exon 18 D842V substitution confers primary intrinsic resistance to imatinib, successfully treated with the targeted kinase inhibitor avapritinib in NAVIGATOR.
Adjuvant imatinib for 3 years significantly improves recurrence-free and overall survival compared to 1 year in high-risk resected GIST in the SSGXVIII/AIO trial.
Sunitinib is the established second-line multi-targeted TKI for advanced GIST progressing on or intolerant to imatinib.
Ripretinib is a switch-pocket kinase inhibitor approved as fourth-line therapy for advanced GIST refractory to imatinib, sunitinib, and regorafenib in INVICTUS.
Risk stratification in GIST utilizes the modified NIH consensus criteria based on primary anatomical tumour site, size, and mitotic rate per 5 mm2 or 50 high-power fields.
SDH-deficient GIST occurs in Carney triad and Carney-Stratakis syndrome, affecting young patients with gastric multinodular tumours exhibiting loss of SDHB expression.
mustKnow.source: WHO Soft Tissue Tumours / DeVita 12e Ch. 39

topics.title: Neuroendocrine neoplasms
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 55 (Neuroendocrine Tumors and Carcinoid Syndrome)

mustKnow.fact: Neuroendocrine tumours NET are graded by Ki-67 proliferation index into well-differentiated G1 under 3%, G2 3% to 20%, G3 over 20%, and poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinomas NEC.

Carcinoid syndrome is driven by systemic serotonin, histamine, and bradykinin secretion from liver metastases, causing episodic cutaneous flushing, secretory diarrhoea, and right-sided cardiac valvular fibrosis.
Urinary 24-hour 5-hydroxyindoleacetic acid 5-HIAA is the primary biochemical diagnostic test for confirming carcinoid syndrome, requiring dietary serotonin restriction during collection.
Gallium-68 DOTATATE or DOTATOC PET-CT imaging binds somatostatin receptor subtype 2 SSTR2 with high affinity, serving as the gold-standard imaging modality for NET staging.
Somatostatin analogues octreotide LAR and lanreotide significantly prolong progression-free survival in advanced well-differentiated gastroenteropancreatic NETs in PROMID and CLARINET.
Peptide receptor radionuclide therapy PRRT with lutetium-177 dotatate significantly improves PFS and overall survival in progressive midgut NETs in the NETTER-1 trial.
Everolimus is an oral mTOR inhibitor approved for progressive, well-differentiated non-functional gastrointestinal and lung NETs based on RADIANT-4.
Poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma NEC exhibits high Ki-67 exceeding 50% with TP53 and RB1 mutations, managed upfront with platinum-etoposide chemotherapy.

modules.name: Localized and biochemically recurrent prostate cancer

topics.title: Localized and biochemically recurrent prostate cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 45 (Localized Prostate Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: Prostate cancer histological grading uses the International Society of Urological Pathology ISUP Grade Groups 1 to 5 derived from primary and secondary Gleason architectural patterns.
Multiparametric MRI mpMRI of the prostate evaluated by PI-RADS v2.1 detects clinically significant tumours with high negative predictive value, guiding targeted biopsy.
Active surveillance with serial PSA, digital rectal examination, mpMRI, and repeat biopsy is the preferred initial management for favourable low-risk localized prostate cancer.
Radical prostatectomy with bilateral pelvic lymphadenectomy provides definitive surgical local control and accurate pathological staging for intermediate- and high-risk disease.
Definitive external beam radiation therapy combined with 18 to 36 months of long-term androgen deprivation therapy ADT is the gold standard for high-risk localized prostate cancer.
Prostate-specific membrane antigen PSMA PET-CT provides superior diagnostic sensitivity for detecting occult pelvic nodal and distant metastases compared to conventional imaging in proPSMA.
The STAMPEDE trial established that adding 2 years of abiraterone acetate plus prednisone to ADT and radiotherapy improves overall survival in high-risk non-metastatic prostate cancer.
Biochemical recurrence after radical prostatectomy is defined as PSA of 0.2 ng/mL or higher with a confirmatory rise, triggering early salvage radiotherapy.

topics.title: Advanced prostate cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 45 (Advanced and Castration-Resistant Prostate Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: First-line metastatic hormone-sensitive prostate cancer mHSPC standard of care requires ADT doublet or triplet therapy adding docetaxel, abiraterone, enzalutamide, or apalutamide.

The ARASENS and PEACE-1 trials proved that triplet therapy combining ADT, docetaxel, and novel androgen receptor pathway inhibitors darolutamide or abiraterone significantly prolongs overall survival in high-volume mHSPC.
Lutetium-177-PSMA-617 radioligand therapy significantly improves progression-free and overall survival in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer mCRPC in the VISION trial.
Olaparib PARP inhibitor significantly improves overall survival in mCRPC harbouring homologous recombination repair gene alterations, particularly BRCA1, BRCA2, and ATM in PROfound.

Radium-223 is an alpha-emitting radiopharmaceutical targeting bone turnover that prolongs overall survival and delays skeletal events in mCRPC with symptomatic bone metastases without visceral disease.
Cabazitaxel is a synthetic taxane overcoming docetaxel resistance, significantly improving overall survival compared to abiraterone or enzalutamide post-docetaxel in the CARD trial.
Castration-resistant prostate cancer is defined biologically as disease progression despite serum castrate testosterone below 50 ng/dL or 1.7 nmol/L.
Treatment-emergent neuroendocrine prostate cancer t-NEPC arises via lineage plasticity under androgen receptor pressure, driven by TP53 and RB1 co-loss and treated with platinum-etoposide.

topics.title: Urothelial carcinoma
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 44 (Cancer of the Bladder, Ureter and Renal Pelvis)

mustKnow.fact: Transurethral resection of bladder tumour TURBT followed by intravesical Bacillus Calmette-Guerin BCG immunotherapy is the standard organ-sparing approach for high-risk non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.
Neoadjuvant cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy dose-dense MVAC or gemcitabine-cisplatin followed by radical cystectomy significantly improves overall survival in muscle-invasive bladder cancer.

First-line enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab EV-302 demonstrated unprecedented doubling of progression-free and overall survival compared to platinum chemotherapy in advanced urothelial carcinoma.

Switch maintenance avelumab PD-L1 inhibitor significantly improves overall survival in patients with locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma not progressing on frontline gemcitabine-platinum in JAVELIN Bladder 100.
Erdafitinib is an oral pan-FGFR tyrosine kinase inhibitor approved for locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma harbouring susceptible FGFR3 genetic alterations in the THOR trial.
Adjuvant nivolumab for 1 year significantly prolongs disease-free survival in patients with high-risk muscle-invasive urothelial carcinoma after radical cystectomy in CheckMate 274.

Upper tract urothelial carcinoma UTUC arises in the renal pelvis or ureter, enriched for Lynch syndrome mismatch repair mutations and managed with radical nephroureterectomy with bladder cuff excision.
Trimodality bladder preservation combining maximal TURBT with concurrent chemoradiotherapy achieves comparable long-term cancer-specific survival in selected non-metastatic candidates.

topics.title: Renal cell carcinoma
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 43 (Renal Cell Carcinoma)

mustKnow.fact: Clear cell renal cell carcinoma ccRCC is driven by biallelic von Hippel-Lindau VHL gene inactivation on chromosome 3p, causing constitutive HIF-1alpha and HIF-2alpha transcription factor accumulation.

The International Metastatic RCC Database Consortium IMDC model stratifies prognosis into favourable, intermediate, and poor risk based on performance status, diagnosis-to-treatment interval, anaemia, hypercalcaemia, neutrophilia, and thrombocytosis.
First-line combination of pembrolizumab plus axitinib significantly improves progression-free and overall survival compared to sunitinib monotherapy in advanced RCC in KEYNOTE-426.
Nivolumab plus ipilimumab dual immunotherapy establishes superior overall survival and high complete response rates in IMDC intermediate- and poor-risk metastatic RCC in CheckMate 214.
First-line cabozantinib plus nivolumab CheckMate 9ER and lenvatinib plus pembrolizumab CLEAR demonstrate significant progression-free and overall survival superiority over sunitinib in advanced RCC.
Belzutifan is a first-in-class oral small-molecule HIF-2alpha inhibitor approved for advanced clear cell RCC progressing after immune checkpoint and VEGFR-TKI therapy in LITESPARK-005.
Adjuvant pembrolizumab for 1 year significantly improves disease-free and overall survival in resected intermediate-high and high-risk renal cell carcinoma in KEYNOTE-564.
Non-clear cell RCC variants include papillary RCC associated with MET alterations, chromophobe RCC exhibiting wholesale chromosomal losses, and aggressive collecting duct carcinoma.

topics.title: Germ cell tumours
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 46 (Testicular and Extragonadal Germ Cell Tumors)

mustKnow.fact: Testicular germ cell tumours GCT are divided histologically into seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumours NSGCT, all sharing the hallmark pathognomonic isochromosome 12p i(12p).
Serum tumour markers AFP, beta-hCG, and LDH are mandatory for staging and risk stratification; AFP is never elevated in pure seminoma and confirms a nonseminomatous component.

The International Germ Cell Cancer Collaborative Group IGCCCG classification stratifies metastatic GCT into good, intermediate, and poor prognosis categories based on histology, primary site, and post-orchiectomy marker nadir.
Standard first-line curative chemotherapy for good-risk metastatic germ cell tumours is 3 cycles of BEP bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin or 4 cycles of EP.
Intermediate- and poor-risk metastatic GCT require 4 cycles of BEP chemotherapy, requiring vigilant monitoring for bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity and oxygen exposure restrictions.
Post-chemotherapy residual retroperitoneal masses 1 cm or larger in nonseminoma mandate nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection RPLND to excise residual teratoma or viable malignancy.
Stage I seminoma after radical inguinal orchiectomy can be safely managed with active surveillance alone, reserving single-dose carboplatin AUC 7 or para-aortic radiotherapy for selected patients.
Salvage chemotherapy for relapsed germ cell tumours utilizes conventional-dose TIP paclitaxel, ifosfamide, cisplatin or high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem cell rescue.

topics.title: Penile and adrenal cancers
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 47 & 56 (Penile and Adrenal Cortical Cancers)

mustKnow.fact: Penile squamous cell carcinoma is associated with human papillomavirus HPV infection in 40% to 50% of cases, primarily spreading sequentially to superficial and deep inguinal lymph nodes.
Dynamic sentinel lymph node biopsy or modified bilateral inguinal lymphadenectomy is indicated in clinical stage T1b or higher penile cancers with non-palpable groins.
Neoadjuvant combination chemotherapy with TIP paclitaxel, ifosfamide, and cisplatin induces high objective response rates in bulky, fixed regional inguinal nodal penile metastases.
Adrenocortical carcinoma ACC is a rare, highly aggressive malignancy frequently presenting with Cushing syndrome, virilization, or abdominal mass.
The Weiss histopathological score predicts malignancy in adrenocortical neoplasms based on 9 criteria, where a score of 3 or more establishes carcinoma.
Mitotane is an adrenolytic agent used in adjuvant and metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma, requiring plasma concentration monitoring to maintain therapeutic levels between 14 and 20 mg/L.
The international FIRM-ACT trial established EDP-mitotane etoposide, doxorubicin, cisplatin, and mitotane as the first-line systemic standard of care for advanced adrenocortical carcinoma.
Malignant pheochromocytomas and paragangliomas are defined by metastatic spread to non-chromaffin tissues, strongly enriched for germline succinate dehydrogenase subunit B SDHB mutations.

topics.title: Epithelial ovarian cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 49 (Epithelial Ovarian and Fallopian Tube Cancer)

mustKnow.fact: High-grade serous ovarian carcinoma characteristically arises from the fimbriated end of the fallopian tube via serous tubal intraepithelial carcinoma STIC lesions with ubiquitous TP53 mutations.
Primary cytoreductive surgery aims for complete macroscopic resection R0, which provides the most critical independent determinant of progression-free and overall survival.
First-line systemic therapy for advanced ovarian cancer is carboplatin AUC 5-6 plus paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 every 3 weeks for 6 cycles, with or without bevacizumab in GOG-0218.
Maintenance olaparib for 2 years significantly prolongs progression-free survival in newly diagnosed advanced BRCA-mutated ovarian cancer, reducing progression risk by 70% in SOLO-1.
Maintenance niraparib provides significant progression-free survival benefit across all advanced ovarian cancer patients responding to platinum, regardless of BRCA mutation or HRD status in PRIMA.
Platinum-sensitive recurrence occurring 6 months or more after completing frontline platinum is retreated with platinum doublets and maintenance PARP inhibitors.
Mirvetuximab soravtansine is an antibody-drug conjugate targeting folate receptor alpha FRalpha, improving overall survival in platinum-resistant ovarian cancer in the MIRASOL trial.
Hyperthermic intraperitoneal chemotherapy HIPEC with cisplatin at interval cytoreductive surgery improves progression-free and overall survival in stage III ovarian cancer.

topics.title: Cervical cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 50 (Carcinoma of the Cervix)

mustKnow.fact: Persistent infection with high-risk human papillomavirus genotypes 16 and 18 drives over 70% of invasive cervical cancers, mediated by viral E6 and E7 oncoproteins degrading p53 and pRb.
FIGO 2018 staging incorporates radiological imaging and pathological findings, distinguishing stage IB into IB1 under 2 cm, IB2 2 to 3.9 cm, and IB3 4 cm or larger.
Locally advanced cervical cancer stage IB3 to IVA standard of care is external beam radiotherapy with concurrent weekly cisplatin 40 mg/m2 followed by high-dose-rate intracavitary brachytherapy.
Adding pembrolizumab to concurrent chemoradiotherapy significantly improves progression-free and overall survival in newly diagnosed locally advanced cervical cancer in KEYNOTE-A18.

First-line pembrolizumab added to chemotherapy with or without bevacizumab significantly prolongs overall survival in persistent, recurrent, or metastatic cervical cancer with PD-L1 CPS 1 or higher in KEYNOTE-826.

The landmark GOG 240 trial established that adding the anti-VEGF monoclonal antibody bevacizumab to platinum-paclitaxel doublet chemotherapy significantly prolongs overall survival in advanced cervical cancer.

Tisotumab vedotin is a tissue factor-directed antibody-drug conjugate demonstrating significant overall survival improvement over chemotherapy in recurrent or metastatic cervical cancer in innovaTV 301.

The INTERLACE trial demonstrated that 6 weeks of induction chemotherapy with carboplatin and paclitaxel immediately prior to chemoradiation significantly improves progression-free and overall survival.

topics.title: Endometrial cancer
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 51 (Endometrial Cancer and Uterine Sarcomas)

mustKnow.fact: The TCGA molecular classification categorises endometrial cancer into 4 distinct prognostic groups: POLE ultramutated, MMR-deficient dMMR, p53-abnormal p53abn, and no specific molecular profile NSMP.

POLE ultramutated endometrial cancers carry mutations in the exonuclease domain, generating extraordinarily high somatic mutation burdens and conferring an exceptionally favourable clinical prognosis.
In advanced or recurrent dMMR/MSI-H endometrial cancer, dostarlimab added to carboplatin and paclitaxel resulted in a 72% reduction in progression or death in the RUBY trial.

Pembrolizumab combined with lenvatinib significantly improves progression-free and overall survival compared to physician's choice chemotherapy in advanced mismatch repair-proficient pMMR endometrial cancer in KEYNOTE-775.
Frontline systemic chemotherapy for metastatic or advanced endometrial carcinoma is carboplatin AUC 5 plus paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 administered every 3 weeks based on GOG-0209.
PORTEC-3 demonstrated that combined adjuvant chemoradiotherapy improves overall and failure-free survival compared to pelvic external beam radiotherapy alone in high-risk endometrial cancer.
Uterine serous carcinoma is an aggressive, high-grade subtype exhibiting ubiquitous TP53 mutations, frequent HER2 amplification in 30%, and a propensity for early peritoneal dissemination.
Uterine carcinosarcoma malignant mixed Mullerian tumour is a true metaplastic epithelial carcinoma, managed aggressively with systemic carboplatin-paclitaxel chemotherapy.

modules.name: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and rare gynaecological cancers

topics.title: Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia and rare gynaecological cancers
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 52 (Gestational Trophoblastic Disease and Rare Gyn Malignancies)

mustKnow.fact: Complete hydatidiform moles are diploid, androgenetic 46,XX or 46,XY conceptuses lacking embryonic fetal tissue, carrying a 15% to 20% risk of malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.
Post-molar GTN is diagnosed by serum beta-hCG plateaus over 4 consecutive values across 3 weeks, consecutive rises over 2 weeks, or histological choriocarcinoma.
The FIGO/WHO prognostic scoring system stratifies GTN into low-risk score 0 to 6 managed with single-agent chemotherapy and high-risk score 7 or higher requiring combination regimens.
Low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia is treated with single-agent intramuscular methotrexate with folinic acid rescue or pulsed intravenous actinomycin D.
High-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia is treated with multi-agent EMA-CO etoposide, methotrexate, actinomycin D, cyclophosphamide, and vincristine, curing over 90% of patients.
Placental site trophoblastic tumour PSTT arises from intermediate trophoblast, secretes human placental lactogen hPL with low beta-hCG, and is relatively chemoresistant requiring hysterectomy.
Invasive vulvar squamous cell carcinoma spreading to regional groin lymph nodes mandates inguinal femoral lymphadenectomy or sentinel node biopsy for depth over 1 mm.
Malignant ovarian germ cell tumours dysgerminoma, endodermal sinus tumour are exquisitely chemosensitive, curable with fertility-sparing surgery and BEP chemotherapy.

sections.name: Head and neck, CNS, skin and sarcoma

modules.name: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma

topics.title: Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 25 & 26 (Cancers of the Oral Cavity, Larynx and Oropharynx)

mustKnow.fact: Head and neck squamous cell carcinomas HNSCC arise from mucosal surfaces, with tobacco and alcohol driving oral cavity cancers and high-risk HPV16 driving oropharyngeal cancers.
HPV-positive oropharyngeal cancer is defined by strong, diffuse p16 immunohistochemical staining and carries a significantly more favourable prognosis in AJCC 8th edition staging.
Definitive concurrent chemoradiotherapy with high-dose cisplatin 100 mg/m2 every 3 weeks is the standard organ-preservation approach for locally advanced laryngeal and pharyngeal cancers.
Induction TPF docetaxel, cisplatin, 5-FU followed by chemoradiotherapy improves larynx preservation and progression-free survival in unresectable locally advanced HNSCC.
First-line pembrolizumab monotherapy for PD-L1 CPS 1 or higher or pembrolizumab plus platinum-5FU significantly improves overall survival in recurrent or metastatic HNSCC in KEYNOTE-048.
Cetuximab bio-radiotherapy Bonner regimen improves overall survival over radiotherapy alone, offering an effective option for cisplatin-ineligible locally advanced HNSCC.

Low-dose nivolumab 20 mg flat dose combined with triple metronomic oral chemotherapy significantly prolonged overall survival in recurrent/metastatic head and neck cancer in an Indian randomized trial.
Postoperative concurrent chemoradiation is indicated for adverse pathological features including positive surgical margins and extracapsular nodal extension based on EORTC 22931 and RTOG 9501.

topics.title: Nasopharyngeal and salivary gland cancers
topics.book: DeVita 12e Ch. 24 & 29 (Nasopharyngeal and Salivary Gland Cancers)

mustKnow.fact: Nasopharyngeal carcinoma NPC is endemic in southern China and Southeast Asia, strongly linked to Epstein-Barr virus EBV infection, predominantly non-keratinizing undifferentiated WHO type III histology.
Plasma cell-free Epstein-Barr virus EBV DNA copy number serves as a highly accurate biomarker for nasopharyngeal carcinoma staging, post-radiotherapy surveillance, and residual disease monitoring.
